Only functional aspects (ribbons, dancers, grass) are present. The structural deviation is severe enough to warrant a low alignment score despite the classifier's confidence.

Secondary artifacts include significant pose uncertainty in the dancers (high ratio of low-confidence keypoints in limbs/hands), suggesting fusion or anatomical ambiguity where ribbons meet hands. The background shows mild painterly smudging. The combination of a major structural hallucination and widespread limb/keypoint uncertainty results in a moderate-to-low artifact score.
